limitations: Prospective only: does not reconstruct earlier callback failures.
Only ProviderError during the validated exchange is logged; preclaim HTTP errors and post-exchange HTTP/final-save failures stay silent and retain generic UI behavior.
reviewed: Only two runtime files plus one new test; no auth,scope,token,asset,DB,schema,ACL,financial,Google,private or frontend behavior change
Sole production exchange call occurs after committed valid flow claim; real service tests prove persisted consumed/cleared flow before provider IO
Anonymous,wrong cookie,expired,owner-disabled and replayed callback failures cannot emit provider diagnostic logs
Request-local ContextVar reset in finally; concurrent requests and cancellation do not mix or leak metadata
Per-stage clearing removes stale HTTP/Graph fields; scope reason is one of four root-approved fixed values, never grant names
Logger has fixed event prefix and JSON allowlist; no exception repr,traceback,URL,token,state,cookie,hash,provider messages or payloads
Provider assets and successful callbacks emit no callback failure event
